verdict.rationale: SerpApi's core value (search scraping) is fully API-driven with rich parameters, formats (json/html/md), archive retrieval, and caching (serpapi-docs-3/9/13/14), but account-level UI features like ZeroTrace Mode, Automatic Early Renewal, and the API metrics dashboard show no evidence of being toggleable or queryable via API rather than the web dashboard. No OpenAPI spec was found (serpapi-probe-3), making it unclear how comprehensively account/billing settings are exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: API endpoints/parameters for account settings (ZeroTrace, auto-renewal), API access to metrics/dashboard data, and explicit documentation confirming full UI-API parity beyond search functionality.
